text: The Patriots are heading into Week 6 against the Jets with some good news on the injury front: A.J. Brown has been activated from injured reserve after missing four games with a right high ankle sprain, though the star wide receiver was cautious about his availability, saying his status remained "still up in the air" as the week progressed. New England will host New York at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, October 18 at 1 PM ET looking to extend a winning streak to three games, with the 2-3 Jets arriving as a potential upset threat behind Geno Smith's impressive no-interception streak. The Patriots also elevated safety Elliott Davison from the practice squad for the matchup, while this week's storylines include how the team's 2026 rookie class—two of whom have assumed starting roles—continues to develop through five weeks. Beyond the field, Patriots fans also mourned the passing of Jon Morris, the former AFL and NFL center who spent 11 of his 15-year career with the Boston and New England Patriots and died at age 84.
